title: odontocline laciniata
intro: Odontocline laciniata, commonly known as Toothache Plant, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. The Toothache Plant has been used for its medicinal properties, providing relief from toothaches, headaches, and other minor aches and pains due to its anti-inflammatory and analgesic properties. Its health benefits include reducing pain and inflammation, while its therapeutic actions include exhibiting antibacterial, antifungal, and antiviral properties, making it useful for treating a range of conditions from skin irritations to respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of Odontocline laciniata include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
